1879060702.name: Intent Concentration
1879060702.desc: In a desperate time, instantly reach full Focus.

1879064286.name: Sweeping Cut
1879064286.desc: A sweeping back-and forth strike in a frontal arc.

1879073374.name: Swift Bow: Star-light
1879073374.desc: Loose two missiles in rapid succession.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879073758.name: Sudden Pounce
1879073758.desc: Unseen till the last moment, you leap at your target and knock it down to the ground.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879125726.name: a ranged attack
1879125726.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a javelin.

1879139038.name: Frenzy
1879139038.desc: After a critical attack, you drive yourself into a frenzied wrath of tooth and claw.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Critical Response</rgb>

1879198302.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Frost-raven)
1879198302.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879199198.name: Yule Festival Glittering Pony
1879199198.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879213918.name: A Chink in the Armour (Ranged)
1879213918.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879244254.name: Keen Strike
1879244254.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879246046.name: Thrust
1879246046.desc: Deal a thrusting blow to open a Deep Wound.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires the use of Brutal Assault, Retaliate, or Whirling Retaliate.</rgb>

1879252318.name: Mighty Strike
1879252318.desc: The strength of Boromir's arm can lend great force to this mighty strike.

1879260638.name: Call of the Cavalry
1879260638.desc: You cry out with a renewed vigour from atop your steed, disheartening any foolish enough to stand in your way.

1879272286.name: Return to Forlaw
1879272286.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the People of Wildermore, you're able to quickly return to Forlaw in Wildermore This skill is easily interrupted.

1879291102.name: Challenge
1879291102.desc: Draws enemy threat away from your allies.

1879302622.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Squire)
1879302622.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879322078.name: Nature's Mend - Tier 1
1879322078.desc: You call on nature to increase the Morale of your target's fellowship.

1879341278.name: Steed of Winter's Light
1879341278.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879366238.name: Spring Pheasant - Female
1879366238.desc: Brings out a female spring phesant to keep you company.

1879391454.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Elvish Soldier)
1879391454.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879449310.name: Greater Anthem I - Compassion
1879449310.desc: Anthem: Reduces Incoming Damage and increases Frost and Lightning Resistance of all nearby fellowship or raid members.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 2 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>

1879491550.name: Gust of Wind
1879491550.desc: Tearing winds cause frost damage in a small radius.\n\n<rgb=#ff0091>When traited in Nature's Fury, this skill has a chance to spread Burning Embers to nearby foes.</rgb>

1879497694.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497694.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879506654.name: Devotion: Balefire
1879506654.desc: Devoting yourself to fire, your ancient blood calls upon dark gifts taught to your ancestors by the foulest enemies that Middle-earth ever knew. With this power, you transform all your damaging skills into blistering fire attacks, and you gain access to other powers fuelled by fell flames.

1879509342.name: Surprise Strike
1879509342.desc:
Strike the enemy, dealing more damage from behind or when Stealthed.

Critical hits with Surprise Strike are more damaging than most skills.<RGB=#00ff00>

 +10% Positional Damage
 +100% Critical Magnitude</RGB>

1879520606.name: Guise of Hármelak Golden-hand
1879520606.desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Hármelak Golden-hand. Perfect for reminiscing about your time with the Kindred of the Coins!

1879527390.name: Jagged Metal Shard
1879527390.desc: Use the shard in a slashing attack, damaging the target and breaking Shield of Darkness. This power will also harm the user.
